text: Duration: two and a half to three years, both full-time and in-service study are acceptable. Time for Admission Application: Before June 30th Qualifications for Application: 1. All kinds of overseas people, including foreigners and overseas Chinese in Hongkong, Macao, Taiwan and foreign countries. 2. People with undergraduate diplomas or those graduating from a junior college more than 2 years ago Notes: Overseas Chinese should take the National Entrance Examination of every April; Foreigners can enroll without taking exams and should learn Chinese for one year in case of their poor Chinese language skills. Documents Needed: A photocopy of the passport A photocopy of College Graduation Certificate A photocopy of college report card Recommendation Letters from two professors (at least one of them should be full professor) 1-2 academic theses Two-inch color photo without hat
